purpose: Verify employee can view their own official service record in read-only mode
preconditions: Employee is authenticated and has an employee service record
action_or_input: Employee queries own service record
expected_result: HR-EIS displays own service record details; prevents unauthorized modification

purpose: Verify employee holding an additional role (e.g. HOD) still sees own record in read-only mode in employee context
preconditions: Employee is authenticated with dual roles (faculty + HOD) and has a service record
action_or_input: Employee queries own service record under employee context
expected_result: Own service record displayed read-only; permissions of other role govern separate actions

purpose: Verify unauthenticated or unpermitted user cannot access service records
preconditions: User is unauthenticated or has invalid token
action_or_input: User attempts to view service record
expected_result: Access denied (401/403) and denied action recorded where applicable

purpose: Verify HR Administrator can update employee service record and changes are committed auditably
preconditions: HR Administrator is authenticated with hr_admin role and target employee record exists
action_or_input: HR Administrator submits valid updates to employee service record
expected_result: Service record updated consistently and audit log entry created

purpose: Verify cancelling update leaves employee service record unchanged
preconditions: Target employee record exists with baseline data
action_or_input: No commit performed / transaction rollback
expected_result: Official record remains completely unchanged

purpose: Verify non-HR admin cannot modify employee service records
preconditions: Regular faculty/staff employee is authenticated without hr_admin role
action_or_input: Employee attempts to update service record
expected_result: Request rejected with 403 Forbidden; prior record intact

purpose: Verify employee can submit a valid leave request and it enters Pending Current Authority state
preconditions: Employee is authenticated with sufficient leave balance
action_or_input: Employee submits valid Casual leave request with dates and justification
expected_result: Leave request created in pending/submitted status and routed to first authority

purpose: Verify leave request with invalid data or insufficient balance is rejected at submission
preconditions: Employee has insufficient leave balance or submits invalid date range
action_or_input: Employee attempts to submit invalid leave request
expected_result: Submission rejected with validation error; request does not enter approval workflow

purpose: Verify unauthenticated actor or actor without leave permission cannot submit leave
preconditions: User lacks hr_eis leave submission permission or is unauthenticated
action_or_input: User attempts to submit leave request
expected_result: Submission blocked with 401/403; no routed request created

purpose: Verify designated approving authority can approve a pending HR request
preconditions: Leave/HR request is in pending status assigned to HOD authority
action_or_input: HOD approves the request with remarks
expected_result: Request status transitions to approved or next stage; approval recorded auditably

purpose: Verify designated approving authority can reject a pending HR request ending approval path
preconditions: Request is pending current authority
action_or_input: Approving authority rejects the request with remarks
expected_result: Request status becomes rejected and approval workflow terminates

purpose: Verify approving authority can forward request to next configured authority
preconditions: Request is pending current authority with multi-tier workflow
action_or_input: Authority forwards request to next authority (e.g. Registrar/Director)
expected_result: Request recorded as pending next authority

purpose: Verify non-designated authority or unauthorized actor cannot decide a request
preconditions: Request is pending HOD; calling user is regular employee without authority
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to approve or reject request
expected_result: Action blocked with 403 Forbidden; request state unchanged

purpose: Verify employee can track the current status of their own submitted HR requests
preconditions: Employee has submitted requests in the system
action_or_input: Employee queries own submitted request status list/detail
expected_result: HR-EIS returns request details with current status and workflow stage

purpose: Verify employee tracking with no submitted requests receives empty result gracefully
preconditions: Employee has no submitted requests in HR-EIS
action_or_input: Employee queries submitted requests
expected_result: HR-EIS returns empty list or indicates no authorized matching request available

purpose: Verify employee cannot access or track another employee's request without authorization
preconditions: Employee A and Employee B exist; Employee A has submitted a request
action_or_input: Employee B attempts to access Employee A's request detail
expected_result: Access denied (403/404); other employee request not disclosed

purpose: Verify employee can submit yearly appraisal during active submission window
preconditions: Employee is authenticated; appraisal cycle is open/configured
action_or_input: Employee submits appraisal with self-assessment details
expected_result: Appraisal created in submitted status and ready for reviewer assignment

purpose: Verify appraisal submission is rejected when cycle window is closed or inactive
preconditions: Appraisal cycle is closed or inactive
action_or_input: Employee attempts to submit appraisal
expected_result: Submission rejected; appraisal not accepted

purpose: Verify unauthorized actor cannot submit appraisal
preconditions: User lacks employee appraisal submission permission
action_or_input: User attempts to submit appraisal
expected_result: Submission blocked with 401/403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify HR Administrator can assign reviewers to a submitted appraisal
preconditions: Appraisal is in submitted status; HR Admin is authenticated
action_or_input: HR Admin assigns reviewer IDs to appraisal
expected_result: Reviewers assigned; appraisal status transitions to reviewer_assigned / pending_review

purpose: Verify HR Admin can revise reviewer assignment before review begins
preconditions: Appraisal is in reviewer_assigned state; no final review completed
action_or_input: HR Admin updates assigned reviewer list
expected_result: Reviewer assignment updated; appraisal outcome unchanged

purpose: Verify non-HR admin cannot assign appraisal reviewers
preconditions: Regular faculty/staff employee is authenticated without admin role
action_or_input: Employee attempts to assign appraisal reviewers
expected_result: Request rejected with 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify designated reviewer/authority can review and finalize appraisal
preconditions: Appraisal is pending review by designated authority
action_or_input: Designated reviewer submits evaluation and finalizes appraisal
expected_result: Appraisal finalized with score/remarks and status updated to completed/closed

purpose: Verify multi-level appraisal review traversal preserves workflow semantics
preconditions: Appraisal requires secondary review stage (e.g. Director after HOD)
action_or_input: Initial reviewer evaluates and forwards to final authority
expected_result: Appraisal transitions to next review stage according to configured route

purpose: Verify modification or re-finalization of a closed appraisal is blocked
preconditions: Appraisal is already in finalized/closed status
action_or_input: Reviewer attempts to modify evaluation or re-finalize
expected_result: Modification rejected; closed appraisal remains immutable

purpose: Verify actor not designated as reviewer cannot finalize appraisal
preconditions: Appraisal is pending review; non-reviewer attempts decision
action_or_input: Non-designated user attempts to submit review evaluation
expected_result: Action rejected with 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify employee can submit a valid LTC advance request
preconditions: Employee is authenticated with active service record
action_or_input: Employee submits LTC advance request with travel block, estimated cost, and advance amount
expected_result: LTC request created in submitted status and routed for HR verification

purpose: Verify unauthorized user cannot submit LTC advance request
preconditions: Unauthenticated user or user without LTC permissions
action_or_input: User attempts to submit LTC advance request
expected_result: Submission blocked with 401/403 Forbidden; no LTC request created

purpose: Verify employee can submit a valid LTC reimbursement request with bills
preconditions: Employee is authenticated with active service record
action_or_input: Employee submits LTC reimbursement request with claimed amount and bills
expected_result: LTC reimbursement created in submitted status and routed for verification

purpose: Verify unauthorized user cannot submit LTC reimbursement request
preconditions: Unauthenticated user or user without LTC reimbursement permissions
action_or_input: User attempts to submit LTC reimbursement request
expected_result: Submission blocked with 401/403 Forbidden; no request created

purpose: Verify HR Admin can verify LTC request documentation and advance it to approval routing
preconditions: LTC request is in submitted status; HR Admin is authenticated
action_or_input: HR Admin verifies LTC request with verdict=approved/verified
expected_result: LTC request recorded as verified and enters approval routing (pending authority)

purpose: Verify unconfirmed/rejected LTC verification does not enter approval routing
preconditions: LTC request is in submitted status
action_or_input: HR Admin rejects verification (verdict=rejected)
expected_result: Request does not enter approval routing; verification rejection recorded auditably

purpose: Verify non-HR admin cannot verify LTC requests
preconditions: Regular employee is authenticated without hr_admin role
action_or_input: Employee attempts to verify LTC request
expected_result: Action rejected with 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify Accountant can record settlement for approved LTC claim
preconditions: LTC claim is approved; Accountant is authenticated with accountant role
action_or_input: Accountant submits settlement with reference ID and remarks
expected_result: Claim marked settled/paid with disbursement recorded auditably

purpose: Verify approved LTC claim remains in approved/processing state when payment pending
preconditions: LTC claim is approved; external payment processing is pending
action_or_input: Accountant checks approved claims awaiting payment
expected_result: Claim remains in approved state awaiting settlement record

purpose: Verify HR-EIS does not execute external banking/payroll and only records settlement
preconditions: Accountant processes claim settlement
action_or_input: Accountant records settlement reference
expected_result: Only internal settlement and audit record updated; no banking gateway invoked

purpose: Verify non-accountant cannot process LTC claim settlement
preconditions: Regular employee or HR admin without accountant role
action_or_input: User attempts to settle approved LTC claim
expected_result: Action rejected with 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify employee can submit a valid CPDA advance request within available balance
preconditions: Employee has active CPDA balance and valid service record
action_or_input: Employee submits CPDA advance request with advance_type and amount
expected_result: CPDA request created in submitted status and routed for verification

purpose: Verify CPDA advance submission with missing required information is rejected
preconditions: Employee attempts submission with missing amount or purpose
action_or_input: Employee submits invalid CPDA request payload
expected_result: Submission rejected with validation error (400 Bad Request)

purpose: Verify unauthorized user cannot submit CPDA advance request
preconditions: Unauthenticated user or user lacking CPDA submission rights
action_or_input: User attempts to submit CPDA advance request
expected_result: Submission blocked with 401/403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify employee can submit a valid CPDA reimbursement request with expenditure bills
preconditions: Employee has active CPDA entitlement and service record
action_or_input: Employee submits CPDA reimbursement request with bills and amount
expected_result: CPDA reimbursement created in submitted status and routed for verification

purpose: Verify CPDA reimbursement submission with missing bills or required fields is rejected
preconditions: Employee submits incomplete reimbursement payload
action_or_input: Employee submits reimbursement without required details
expected_result: Submission rejected with validation error (400 Bad Request)

purpose: Verify unauthorized user cannot submit CPDA reimbursement request
preconditions: User lacks CPDA reimbursement rights
action_or_input: User attempts to submit CPDA reimbursement request
expected_result: Submission blocked with 401/403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify HR Admin can verify submitted CPDA claim and route it to approval
preconditions: CPDA claim is in submitted status; HR Admin is authenticated
action_or_input: HR Admin verifies CPDA claim with verdict=approved/verified
expected_result: CPDA claim recorded as verified and enters approval routing

purpose: Verify unconfirmed CPDA verification does not enter approval routing
preconditions: CPDA claim is in submitted status
action_or_input: HR Admin rejects CPDA verification (verdict=rejected)
expected_result: Claim remains outside approval routing; verification rejection recorded auditably

purpose: Verify non-HR admin cannot verify CPDA claims
preconditions: Regular employee is authenticated without hr_admin role
action_or_input: Employee attempts to verify CPDA claim
expected_result: Action rejected with 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify Accountant can settle approved CPDA claim and deduct balance
preconditions: CPDA claim is approved; Accountant is authenticated; service record exists
action_or_input: Accountant submits settlement with voucher_no and remarks
expected_result: Claim status updated to settled/paid and CPDA balance deducted in service record

purpose: Verify approved CPDA claim remains in approved state until settlement is received
preconditions: CPDA claim is approved; settlement has not been recorded
action_or_input: Accountant inspects approved CPDA claims
expected_result: Claim remains in approved state awaiting settlement recording

purpose: Verify HR-EIS does not execute direct bank disbursement or alter payroll rules
preconditions: Accountant records settlement
action_or_input: Accountant settles approved CPDA claim
expected_result: Only internal claim status, service record balance, and audit log updated

purpose: Verify non-accountant cannot settle CPDA claims
preconditions: Regular employee or HR admin without accountant role
action_or_input: User attempts to settle CPDA claim
expected_result: Action rejected with 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify HR Admin can configure module workflow settings within HR-EIS scope
preconditions: HR Admin is authenticated with workflow configuration permissions
action_or_input: HR Admin updates workflow configuration (e.g. leave auto-forwarding or thresholds)
expected_result: Workflow settings updated and recorded auditably

purpose: Verify HR-EIS rejects configuring settings outside module scope (e.g. platform RBAC)
preconditions: HR Admin attempts to pass unsupported or external setting keys
action_or_input: HR Admin submits invalid configuration keys
expected_result: Configuration rejected or external keys ignored; invalid configuration blocked

purpose: Verify non-HR admin cannot modify workflow settings
preconditions: Regular employee is authenticated without admin role
action_or_input: Employee attempts to update workflow configuration
expected_result: Action rejected with 403 Forbidden; settings remain unchanged

purpose: Verify HR Admin can view immutable audit log records with actor, timestamp, and action
preconditions: HR Admin is authenticated; audit log records exist in the system
action_or_input: HR Admin queries audit log endpoint
expected_result: Audit logs returned with actor ID, timestamp, action type, and details

purpose: Verify audit history for rejected or returned requests remains available and intact
preconditions: A rejected or returned request exists in the audit trail
action_or_input: HR Admin queries audit logs filtered by target request or action
expected_result: Audit records for rejected/returned request returned accurately without omission

purpose: Verify non-authorized users cannot access compliance and audit logs
preconditions: Regular faculty/staff employee is authenticated without audit permissions
action_or_input: Employee attempts to query audit log records
expected_result: Access denied with 403 Forbidden

purpose: Verify user can view notifications addressed to their user ID or role
preconditions: User is authenticated; notifications exist addressed to the user
action_or_input: User queries notification list endpoint
expected_result: Notifications addressed to user displayed with message, timestamp, and read status

purpose: Verify policy/deadline notifications appear when configured in the system
preconditions: A policy/deadline notification has been issued to the user
action_or_input: User queries notification list
expected_result: Policy notification displayed with correct details

purpose: Verify notifications not addressed to the actor are not disclosed
preconditions: User A and User B exist; notification addressed only to User B
action_or_input: User A queries notifications
expected_result: User B's notification is not present in User A's notification list

purpose: Verify system generates pending-action reminder notification for requests pending authority decision
preconditions: Request is pending current authority; reminder service is triggered
action_or_input: Reminder generation logic evaluates pending request
expected_result: Reminder notification created addressed to current pending authority

purpose: Verify resolved request does not generate reminder notifications
preconditions: Request is already in approved or rejected status
action_or_input: Reminder evaluation runs for resolved request
expected_result: No reminder notification is generated for resolved request

purpose: Verify reminder notification addresses only the currently responsible authority when multiple roles exist
preconditions: Request is pending stage 1 authority in a multi-tier routing
action_or_input: Reminder generation executes
expected_result: Notification generated only for the stage 1 authority, not stage 2 authority

purpose: Verify request information is not disclosed to unauthorized users if recipient cannot be determined
preconditions: Pending request has invalid or unresolvable routing recipient
action_or_input: Reminder service evaluates request
expected_result: No notification sent to arbitrary or unauthorized users; request state unchanged

purpose: Verify system generates policy/deadline update notification when configured event occurs
preconditions: Policy deadline event is configured with target audience
action_or_input: Policy notification service issues broadcast/targeted notification
expected_result: Notification generated for authorized recipient and visible in dashboard view

purpose: Verify unconfigured policy/deadline events do not generate spurious notifications
preconditions: No policy/deadline event is configured
action_or_input: Notification dispatch runs
expected_result: No spurious notifications generated

purpose: Verify policy notification recipient scope strictly follows configured role/access restrictions
preconditions: Policy notification configured specifically for faculty role
action_or_input: Policy notification dispatched
expected_result: Notification addressed to faculty; staff users do not receive faculty-specific notification

purpose: Verify recipient authorization failure prevents notification disclosure
preconditions: User lacks authorization for specific sensitive policy notice
action_or_input: User queries notifications
expected_result: Sensitive notice not disclosed to unauthorized user
